en: Hello {person}, we issued {qty} {ppe} on {date}. Please wear it every day for the work it is made for, and tell me when it is worn out.
mt: Draag het alsjeblieft elke dag voor het werk waarvoor het is gemaakt, en vertel me wanneer het versleten is.

en: Machine: {col:machines.name} ({col:machines.kind}). Status: {col:machines.owned}. Bought on {col:machines.buy_date} for {col:machines.price}.
mt: De machine: {col:machines.name} ({col:machines.kind}). Status: {col:machines.owned}.

en: The machine is {col:machines.age} years old with a planned life of {col:machines.life_years} years. Its value now is {col:machines.value_now}. The age check shows: {col:machines.state}.
mt: De machine is {col:machines.age} jaar oud met een geplande levensduur van {col:machines.life_years} jaar.

en: Parts cost {col:repairs.parts_cost}. The workshop worked {col:repairs.labour_h} hours, which costs {col:repairs.labour_cost}. The total cost is {col:repairs.cost}.
mt: De werkplaats werkte {col:repairs.labour_h} uur, wat {col:repairs.labour_cost} kost.

en: In the last 12 months the machine used {col:machines.fuel_l} litres of diesel in {col:machines.hours_year} hours. The fuel cost was {col:machines.fuel_cost}.
mt: In de afgelopen 12 maanden heeft de machine {col:machines.fuel_l} liter diesel gebruikt in {col:machines.hours_year} uur.

en: The diesel price used is the average price paid on your fuel purchases. Every dip of the tank is compared with the stock in the books and a difference of more than {set:fuel_loss} is checked.
mt: De gebruikte dieselprijs is de gemiddelde prijs die u betaalt voor de aankoop van brandstof.

en: Worker: {col:workers.name} from {col:workers.country}. Type: {col:workers.type}. Main task: {col:workers.main_task}.
mt: Werknemer: {col:workers.name} van {col:workers.country}. Type: {col:workers.type}.

en: Month: {col:payroll.month}. Prepared by {col:payroll.manager}.
mt: Maand: voorbereid door {col:payroll.manager}.

en: Permanent staff pay is {col:payroll.perm_pay}, seasonal workers pay is {col:payroll.seasonal_pay} and piece-rate pay is {col:payroll.piece_pay}. Allowances and bonuses are {col:payroll.allowances}. The total pay is {col:payroll.pay_total}.
mt: Het loon van de vaste personeelsleden is {col:payroll.perm_pay}, het loon van de seizoenarbeiders is {col:payroll.seasonal_pay} en het stukloon is {col:payroll.piece_pay}.

en: Employer costs are {col:payroll.oncost_amt}, so the labour cost of the month is {col:payroll.labour_cost} for {col:payroll.hours} hours. The budget was {col:payroll.budget} and the check shows: {col:payroll.state}.
mt: De kosten van de werkgever zijn {col:payroll.oncost_amt}, dus de arbeidskosten van de maand zijn {col:payroll.labour_cost} voor {col:payroll.hours} uur.

en: Picker: {col:workers.name}. Team leader: {col:workers.leader}.
mt: Teamleider:

en: During the contract the picker delivered {col:workers.piece_kg} kilograms of accepted fruit and vegetables. The piece-rate pay is {col:workers.piece_pay}.
mt: Tijdens het contract levert de plukker {col:workers.piece_kg} kg aanvaarde groenten en fruit.

en: Time work on other days was paid {col:workers.pay}. The total pay is {col:workers.total_pay} for {col:workers.hours} hours.
mt: Het totale loon is {col:workers.total_pay} voor {col:workers.hours} uur.

en: Month: {col:labourneed.month}. Planned by {col:labourneed.manager}.
mt: Maand: {col:labourneed.month}.

en: The farm work of the month needs {col:labourneed.hours_needed} hours, which is {col:labourneed.fte} full-time workers. We have {col:labourneed.perm_workers} permanent staff, so we need {col:labourneed.seasonal_needed} seasonal workers.
mt: De boerderijwerkzaamheden van de maand hebben {col:labourneed.hours_needed} uur nodig, dat is {col:labourneed.fte} voltijdswerkers.

en: We have {col:labourneed.seasonal_hired} seasonal workers on contract, so {col:labourneed.gap} workers are still short. The check shows: {col:labourneed.state}.
mt: We hebben seizoenarbeiders op contract, dus er is nog steeds een tekort aan arbeiders.

en: What happened: {col:safety.what}. How serious: {col:safety.severity}. Days lost: {col:safety.days_lost}. Cost: {col:safety.cost}.
mt: Wat is er gebeurd, hoe ernstig, dagen verloren, kosten...

en: The action check shows: {col:safety.state}. The record was closed on {col:safety.closed_on}.
mt: De actiecontrole toont aan: {col:safety.state}.

en: Hello {contact}, ticket {ticket_id}: weight leaving the farm {net_kg} kg, your weight {buyer_kg} kg, difference {diff_pct}. Weight check: {state}.
mt: Hallo {contact}, ticket {ticket_id}: gewicht verlaten van de boerderij {net_kg} kg, uw gewicht {buyer_kg} kg, verschil {diff_pct}.

en: Hello {contact}, quality result for delivery {line_id} of {product}: deduction {ded_pct}, worth {ded_value}. The paid weight is {net_t} t at {price_t} per tonne.
mt: Hallo {contact}, kwaliteitsresultaat voor de levering {line_id} van {product}: aftrek {ded_pct}, waarde {ded_value}.

en: Hello {contact}, thank you for your payment of {amount} received on {date} for invoice {invoice}. Payment type: {type}.
mt: Hallo {contact}, bedankt voor uw betaling van {amount} ontvangen op {date} voor de factuur {invoice}.

en: Hello {contact}, contract {contract}: {delivered} t delivered of {contract_t} t, {left} t left, window ends {win_end}. Our forecast shows a shortfall of {shortfall} t. Can we agree a plan?
mt: Hallo {contact}, contract {contract}: {delivered} t geleverd van {contract_t} t, {left} t links, venster eindigt {win_end}.

en: Hello, please book a truck for job {h_id} on {date}: {tonnes} t for {buyer}, about {km} km. Please confirm the truck and the loading time.
mt: Hallo, boek een vrachtwagen voor de klus op {date}: {tonnes} t voor {buyer}, ongeveer {km} km.

en: Hello, we agree a rate of {rate} per tonne-km plus a fixed charge of {fixed} for job {h_id}. This gives {cost} for {tonnes} t. Please confirm.
mt: Hallo, we zijn het eens over een tarief van {rate} per ton-km plus een vaste vergoeding van {fixed} voor werk {h_id}.

en: Hello {driver}, please bring the weighbridge slip for ticket {ticket_id} to the office as soon as you return. Net weight {net_kg} kg.
mt: Hallo {driver}, breng alstublieft de weegbrief voor het ticket {ticket_id} naar het kantoor zodra u terugkeert.

en: Hello {staff}, the stall at {market} opens at {opens} on {date}. Please load {taken_kg} kg of {product} and the price list at {price_kg} per kg.
mt: Hallo {staff}, de kraan op {market} opent op {opens} op {date}.

en: Hello, buyer {buyer} owes {owed} and the credit limit is {limit}. Please decide today whether we deliver more before they pay.
mt: Hallo, de koper heeft een schuld en de kredietlimiet is twee.

en: Payment terms are {col:invoices.terms} days, so this invoice is due on {col:invoices.due}. Payments received so far: {col:invoices.paid}. Balance: {col:invoices.balance}.
mt: Betalingstermijnen zijn {col:invoices.terms} dagen, dus deze factuur is verschuldigd op {col:invoices.due}.

en: To {col:lines.buyer}. Contact: {col:lines.contact}. Order: {col:lines.order}. Contract: {col:lines.contract}.
mt: Contact, bestelling, contract.

en: The agreed price is {col:lines.price_t} per tonne and the sale value is {col:lines.value}. The haulage cost is {col:lines.haul}.
mt: De overeengekomen prijs is {col:lines.price_t} per ton en de verkoopwaarde is {col:lines.value}.

en: The seller will deliver {col:contracts.tonnes} tonnes of {col:contracts.product} at {col:contracts.price_t} per tonne, a total value of {col:contracts.value}. Delivery is between {col:contracts.win_start} and {col:contracts.win_end}.
mt: De verkoper zal {col:contracts.tonnes} ton {col:contracts.product} leveren tegen {col:contracts.price_t} per ton, voor een totale waarde van {col:contracts.value}.

en: If the seller delivers less than the contracted quantity inside the window, the buyer may charge a penalty of {col:contracts.penalty_pct} of the value of the missing tonnes. The buyer pays within the terms agreed in the buyer file.
mt: Indien de verkoper in de verkoopruimte minder dan de contractuele hoeveelheid levert, kan de koper een boete in rekening brengen van de waarde van de ontbrekende tonnen.

en: Contracted: {col:fulfil.contract_t} tonnes. Delivered: {col:fulfil.delivered} tonnes, which is {col:fulfil.pct}. Left to deliver: {col:fulfil.left} tonnes before {col:fulfil.win_end}.
mt: Contract: {col:fulfil.contract_t} ton. Leverde: {col:fulfil.delivered} ton, wat {col:fulfil.pct} is.

en: To finish in time we need {col:fulfil.per_week} tonnes each week. The harvest can still give {col:fulfil.forecast_t} tonnes, so the shortfall is {col:fulfil.shortfall} tonnes and the penalty at stake is {col:fulfil.penalty}. Status: {col:fulfil.state}.
mt: De oogst kan nog steeds {col:fulfil.forecast_t} ton geven, dus het tekort is {col:fulfil.shortfall} ton en de straf op het spel is {col:fulfil.penalty}.

en: To {col:ageing.buyer}. Contact: {col:ageing.contact}.
mt: Contact: {col:ageing.contact}.

en: We checked our weighbridge and quality records. Our offer to settle is {col:claims.agreed}. The claim status is {col:claims.status}.
mt: We hebben onze kwaliteitsgegevens gecontroleerd.

en: Product: {col:plan.product}. Output this year: {col:plan.expected_t} tonnes. Sold this year: {col:plan.sold_t} tonnes at an average of {col:plan.avg_price} per tonne.
mt: Productie dit jaar: {col:plan.expected_t} ton Verkocht dit jaar: {col:plan.sold_t} ton met een gemiddelde van {col:plan.avg_price} ton.

en: Our minimum price is {col:plan.min_price} and the market price is {col:plan.market_now}. The market check shows: {col:plan.state}.
mt: Onze minimumprijs is {col:plan.min_price} en de marktprijs is {col:plan.market_now}.

en: Contracted tonnes: {col:plan.contracted_t}, {col:plan.contract_share} of the output. Stock in store: {col:plan.in_store_t} tonnes, worth {col:plan.stock_value}.
mt: De in de overeenkomst vastgestelde hoeveelheden: {col:plan.contracted_t}, {col:plan.contract_share} van de produktie.
